schema_origin_note: Contrasted against sealed us-corpus-v1 dataset/market=us/year=2024/part-00000.parquet. Real columns only. trading_value is ABSENT — the sealed corpus has no exchange-reported dollar turnover; adapters must not synthesize close×volume into trading_value (price_mode=adjusted would distort).
table_load_policy_authority: code registry CORPUS_TABLE_LOAD_POLICY_BY_ID['us-corpus-v1']; file cannot opt out of SURVIVORSHIP_BIASED label gate
timestamp_storage: session_date is timestamp[ms] naive midnight representing the XNYS session calendar date; no separate raw UTC timestamp column exists in the sealed corpus
session_date_derivation: session_date column is authoritative (XNYS calendar day). No ET re-derivation from a raw UTC timestamp is possible without inventing that timestamp.
trading_value_policy: Do not populate trading_value. Optional named proxy fields are out of this contract; inventing trading_value from adjusted close×volume is forbidden.

notes.session_date: timestamp[ms] naive; .date() is the XNYS session calendar day
notes.nullability: Sealed US parquet is pandas-written with nullable=True on every field; adapter still refuses null cell values at bar construction
notes.market: not a parquet column; adapter injects constant market='US' on the bar object only
notes.calendar: must be an XNYS session; holiday/non-session rows fail loudly
notes.price_mode: adjusted (schema metadata); not a data column

notes.pit: universe at session t uses membership rows <= t only
notes.terminal: delisted holdings require an explicit terminal event
notes.scope: Harness/fixture membership contract only; sealed US corpus is survivorship-biased and has no delist membership table in this job.

manifest.file_sha256: hex lowercase SHA-256 of full file bytes; verified BEFORE parquet parse
